# ADIP LA — Another Day in Paradise (the store)
Hand-drawn meditation art by Farhad Rabbany, Beverly Hills 90210, sold as a self-contained online store: hoodies $175, caps $69, a $300 one-of-one hand-drawn cap commission ($100 deposit), a $39 drawing kit, and canvas prints in five sizes ($200-$350). US shipping $12 flat, free at $200 of goods. One returns rule: 14 days. Studio: 1031 S Wooster Street, Los Angeles 90035, Mon-Fri 10:00-16:00. Contact: info@anotherdayinparadise.la. Social: Instagram/Threads @a.d.i.p.la, Facebook AnotherDayInParadiseADIP. Not food: a London chef uses a similar name; this is hand-drawn art.
Pages: index.html (storefront), shop.html (all 23 pieces with filters), product.html?id=<slug> (every product), commission.html (configurator), cart.html, checkout.html, story.html, faq.html.
